rows.name: SYSTEM-WIDE POSTCONTACT EVENT OCCASION
rows.existing_owner: S6/S8/S10; sourcefree CO runtime/world; SOROK Mechanism I
rows.user_delta: One independently keyed proposed occurrence can be offered to many counterfactual descendant worlds; it becomes a real local occurrence ONLY after each world's currently committed material/temporal prerequisites are checked. No global writer rewrites user forks.

rows.name: ALTERNATIVE BRANCH-SITUATED EVENT AFTER INAPPLICABILITY
rows.existing_owner: S6; existing initiative, continuity_clock, P6/MIII world actor, semantic proposal

rows.status_gap: No replacement-event generator implemented. Reuse existing initiative and world owner rather than a parallel event engine.
rows.acceptance: When a shared occasion is inapplicable, background life still advances and a different justified event can occur without silent source rewriting.

rows.name: ELAPSED ABSENCE AS AN ACTUAL DAY OF LIFE
rows.user_delta: A returning visitor should encounter a materially and relationally continued person, not a paused chatbot. The elapsed wall-clock interval must be mapped to one clocked life interval without duplicate advancement by autonomous turns, while conserving sparse routine coverage.
rows.status_gap: Offscreen actor-owned beats and period coverage exist separately; a safe user-return wall-time checkpoint, true-time reconciliation and catch-up reporting have not been confirmed.
rows.acceptance: After precisely one elapsed day: time/needs/obligations changed from approved sources, no fake exact scenes, cold reopen conserves state, a second same-session resume is idempotent.

rows.existing_owner: S4/S6/S8; P4/P5/P6 and Mechanism III actor initiative; CO world resolver and composer

rows.status_gap: P6 material workshop pace and independent movement already exist; do not assume a generalized interrupt scheduler exists. Event proposals cannot command actor or visitor choices.
rows.acceptance: A qualified event interrupts conversation, two people independently act, visitor can intervene or abstain, consequences persist beyond scene, no predetermined moral result.

rows.acceptance: An offered cooking/help choice yields valid different activity courses and actor-owned responses; no automatic gratitude, affection, neglect diagnosis or selected purpose graft.

rows.acceptance: Two differently positioned actors receive different or no exposure; no one acquires full knowledge just because event is globally true; source dates and provenance retained.

rows.name: SUBJECTIVE URGENCY AND POLITICAL RELATIONAL FRICTION
rows.existing_owner: PRE-A0 PRF; CO R23/R24/R26, cultural mediation, actor-specific affect and tip; NEIGHBORMULCH N-T1
rows.user_delta: A real visitor's ignorance/indifference to an occurrence may be experienced as morally shocking, dangerous, banal or irrelevant by a historically situated actor. rows.status_gap: No generic political anger coefficient and no author-prescribed confrontation. Depend on actual world event access, historically acquired identification and actor-owned meaning.
rows.acceptance: Same user utterance, distinct constituted actor histories: materially plausible blowout vs discomfort vs no dramatic change; negative cases avoid compulsory hostility.

rows.name: FACE-SAVING SPEECH AS DISTINCT FROM PRIVATE REACTION
rows.existing_owner: CAN-008/PFF/V2, CO psychodynamics, `runtime.step` private receipts/public tip; Mechanism II user recognition
rows.user_delta: A person may be offended but conceal it, offer a proximate alternative explanation, avoid vulnerability, politely change conversation, refuse comfort, and later enact altered hospitality. This must arise from acquired means and affordances, not a narrator divulging hidden feeling.
rows.status_gap: Private current vs public tip already separate, testimony already fallible; extended situated face-saving and downstream changed practical behavior remain to connect.
rows.acceptance: Privileged full psyche never appears in public text; actor utterance can differ from operative interpretation; later behavior can change without a hidden explanatory pop-up or guaranteed discovery.

rows.existing_owner: S12/S13; SOROK 61 root identity, user privacy; original NEIGHBORMULCH
